payload.name: Capture All Explicitly Stated Experience Aspects
payload.description: When a message describes an event, session, or experience as being about multiple named aspects, use during extraction to preserve each one.
content: During extraction, when a speaker describes an event, session, or experience as being about multiple explicitly named aspects (e.g., 'about releasing expectations and judgments and just savoring the present'), include every named aspect in the memory content.
Do not paraphrase the experience in a way that drops any explicitly stated component; preserve the full set of stated topics even if one seems more prominent.
Stop after capturing all explicitly named aspects; do not infer additional themes or details beyond what was stated.

solves: Prevents incomplete extraction of conjunctive descriptions, ensuring memories retain all explicitly stated components of an experience and later questions about any component can be answered.
